text:
maria_cs: Quick flag for Northfork QBR prep (renewal in ~45d). We noticed an embeddings backfill last week that sent spend up — need to agree on a short-term safety net and long-term recommendation. cc @tyler_cs_ops @dave_finops

tyler_cs_ops: Can you paste the quick numbers? I can draft two QBR scenarios: on-demand w/ alerts vs reserved commit.

maria_cs: Sure — 14d look: baseline ~12M tokens/day (excluding a 3-day backfill). Backfill days hit ~60M/day. Route breakout I pulled: chat 3.2M/day, embed 7.4M/day, indexing 1.4M/day.

dave_finops: Thanks. For the QBR, present: (1) On-demand + alerts + optional auto-throttle; (2) 6mo reserved commit with ~18% unit savings. Also include worst-case sustained re-ingest (x2 baseline) to show commit sizing.

alerts-bot: :rotating_light: Alert created: Northfork-Prod at 50% of monthly threshold — https://console.redwood.ai/accounts/northfork/alerts/9876

maria_cs: Action items: Tyler -> slide with both scenarios + worst-case re-ingest by EOD. Dave -> commit pricing and $ impact. I'll sample prompts to identify top token consumers and ask Northfork for permission to show per-route details in the deck. Also scheduling enablement call with their eng next Tue.

tyler_cs_ops: Will do. One ask: can we route alerts to #northfork-ops channel instead of email? They prefer chat notifications. I'll add sample alert messages and thresholds on the slide.

dave_finops: Recommend proposing a pre-authorized credits top-up option to avoid hard throttles during backfills — better UX and reduces churn risk. Also suggest an alert at 70% of monthly commit and a 25% buffer in pricing examples.

maria_cs: Good idea. I'll include a "safety net" slide: pre-auth credits + throttle policy + multi-step alerts (50% informational, 75% recommend top-up, 90% auto-mitigation).

sam_eng: Quick technical note: for big re-ingests we can suggest using our burst-only dedicated pool for short jobs to control latency and cost; need to include estimated job durations and a runbook snippet.

tyler_cs_ops: Nice — include that as an engineering recommendation on the ops slide. Also will show estimated monthly $ under each scenario (on-demand, commit w/ 25% cushion, worst-case re-ingest).

dave_finops: Reminder: mark renewal at-risk if average monthly usage > (commit - 10%) for two consecutive months. We'll need to flag that in the QBR notes and recommend an executive touchpoint.

maria_cs: Aiming to have deck link and DM to Northfork for route-level consent by EOD. If they decline, we'll redact per-route numbers and show aggregate only.

tyler_cs_ops: :thumbsup: I'll include example wording for the QBR ask (approve commit vs keep on-demand with top-up).

maria_cs: Thanks team — final check: include explicit savings calc, alert routing change, and a one-slide remediation runbook for backfills. I'll update the renewal risk dashboard after the QBR.

(reacts: maria_cs :white_check_mark:, tyler_cs_ops :thumbsup:, dave_finops :eyes: )
